about_the_game:
Wrench Towers is a tower defense game inspired by the golden age of Flash games, with a modern take on gameplay and pixel art.

♖ Key features ♖

🔹 Strategy at your reach: Forget about purchasing hundreds of new towers. In Wrench Towers you'll upgrade and move existing towers to adapt to ever more challenging waves! 

🔹 Pixel Art: Dive in a world of carefully-crafted pixels evoking the good-old classics.

🔹 Big variety of enemies: We've focused on making Wrench Towers the least the repetitive the possible. Meet new enemies in almost all levels and a new cast for each world. 

🔹Varied levels: Face a series of unique levels with environments, paths and mechanics that will put your cleverness under test.

🔹 Nostalgic soundscape: Get transported to the Flash era with our soundtrack and classic SFX. 

🔹 Easy to play, Hard to master: Designed to be completed by everyone but with enough depth and challenges to keep you hooked in for hours. 

Why play Wrench Towers? 

If you love classic tower defense and are tired of finding no modern takes on the genre or want to get into them for the first time Wrench Towers is perfect for you. With its unique focus on existing tower upgrades while staying true to genre's roots, it offers a fine blend of old and new.

Try Wrench Towers now and begin your journey!

Strategy is key!
